hook.name: SlipstreamAggregator
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that aggregates liquidity from external Slipstream (tickSpacing-keyed concentrated liquidity) pools. On every swap, `beforeSwap` executes the trade on the matched external Slipstream pool and returns a `BeforeSwapDelta` to fully cancel the core v4 swap, routing all liquidity through the external pool instead. Liquidity provision directly into the v4 pool is blocked.
